props.name: cohorts
props.description: One row per cohort, oldest first.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the grid, also the table caption.

props.name: periodLabel
props.description: Column heading for a period index.

props.name: mode
props.description: Show shares or head counts. Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: showModeToggle
props.description: Show the percent / count switch above the grid.

props.name: showAverage
props.description: Add a weighted average row under the cohorts.

props.name: formatCount
props.description: Format head counts in the size column and in count mode.
